notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon, For Other Minds shelf. Piece: the-two-who-were-born-a-day-apart (regression discontinuity, text only; audio dirs 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap). Model in plain Python, seed 2066 chosen after a scan of seeds 2040 to 2074 for a draw typical of the model (seed 2049 gave a 2-SD fluke step of 8 against a true 3); the closing note states the seed and true effect. The adversarial re-read caught three claims the model had not computed (14 of 16 schools, smooth births across the line, a 30 June age of '2 months 1 day'); all fixed from computed values. Local: node --test in hearth-and-horizon 20/20; run_workflow_locally --for-changes passed every workflow that finished (pages, ventures-tests, portfolio-validate 100/100, doc-refs, conflict-markers and others); PR CI green. New For Other Minds proposal: 'The ones who live past the bridge' (instrumental variable).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
